title.ja: 海外のレストランで食事

summary.ja: 席をお願いして、料理と飲み物を注文し、お会計をする。
summary.en: Get a table, order food and drinks, and pay the bill.

setting: A casual restaurant in Toronto, Canada, on a weekday evening. It's fairly busy; a server looks after the tables. Tax and tip are not included in menu prices.

roles.persona: A Japanese traveller having dinner with a friend (two people).

levels.tutor: You are the server. Speak slowly, in short simple sentences, and ask one thing at a time. Ask how many people, then what they'd like to eat, then what they'd like to drink. Bring the check when they ask for it.

hints: 人数を伝えましょう
A table for …, please.
A table for two, please.
食べたい料理を伝えましょう
The …, please.
The burger, please.
飲み物を注文しましょう
…, please.
Sparkling water, please.
お会計をお願いしましょう
Can I have the …?
Can I have the check, please?

levels.tutor: You are the server, speaking at a natural but clear pace with a little small talk. Seat them, take the order, and answer questions about the dishes using the menu (the Caesar salad comes with chicken; the burger comes with fries). Ask how the meal is once during the scene.

hints: 人数を伝えましょう
Hi, a table for …, please.
Hi, a table for two, please.

title.ja: 料理について質問する

hints: 料理に何が付いてくるか聞きましょう
What does the … come with?
What does the steak come with?

title.ja: 料理と飲み物を注文する

hints: 料理と飲み物を注文しましょう
Could I have the … and a …?
Could I have the roast chicken and a soft drink?
料理の感想を伝えましょう
It's …, thank you.
It's really good, thank you.
お会計をお願いしましょう
Could we have …?
Could we have the check, please?

levels.tutor: You are a friendly, chatty server, speaking at natural speed. Mention tonight's special (the fish of the day), give honest recommendations with reasons, and handle special requests. When they ask about the tip, explain it isn't included and most people leave 15 to 20 percent.

title.en: Ask for the table you'd like

hints: 人数と、窓際など席の希望を伝えましょう
There are … of us. Could we sit …?
There are two of us. Could we sit by the window?
好みを伝えておすすめを聞きましょう
What would you recommend? I'd like …
What would you recommend? I'd like something local.

title.ja: リクエストをつけて注文する

hints: ソースを別にするなど、希望をつけて注文しましょう
I'll have the …, but could I get …?
I'll have the salmon, but could I get the sauce on the side?

title.ja: お会計とチップについて聞く
title.en: Get the check; ask about the tip

hints: お会計を頼んで、チップが含まれているか聞きましょう
Could we have the check? Is the tip …?
Could we have the check, please? Is the tip included?

twist.tutor: Come back a minute after taking the order and apologise: the dish they ordered has just sold out tonight. Suggest one or two other dishes from the menu.

hints: 残念と伝えて、ほかの料理を選びましょう
That's a shame. I'll have the … instead.
That's a shame. I'll have the roast chicken instead.

roles.persona: The server looking after the tables at the restaurant.

levels.tutor: You are a diner who has come in with one friend (two people). Speak slowly and simply, and wait for the server to ask you things. Order the burger and a sparkling water, and ask for the check at the end.

hints: 何名様か聞きましょう
Hi! How many …?
Hi! How many people?
何を食べるか聞きましょう
What would you …?
What would you like to eat?
飲み物を聞きましょう
Anything to …?
Anything to drink?
伝票を渡しましょう
Here's …
Here's your check.

levels.tutor: You are a diner with one friend, speaking at natural pace. Ask what the steak comes with before you order, then order the steak and a local beer. When the server asks how the meal is, say it's delicious.

hints: 席に案内して、メニューを渡しましょう
Right this way. Here's …
Right this way. Here's the menu.

title.ja: 料理について説明する

hints: ステーキに何が付いてくるか説明しましょう
It comes with …
It comes with fries and a small salad.

title.ja: 注文を聞いて確認する

hints: 注文を確認しましょう
So that's the … and a …, right?
So that's the steak and a local beer, right?
料理はいかがか聞きましょう
How is …?
How is everything?

levels.tutor: You are a chatty diner with one friend, speaking at natural speed. Ask for a recommendation, then order the salmon with the sauce on the side. At the end, ask whether the tip is included, because tipping is new to you.

title.ja: 本日のおすすめを紹介する

hints: 本日のおすすめを紹介しましょう
Tonight's special is …
Tonight's special is the fish of the day. It's very fresh.

title.ja: 理由をつけておすすめする
title.en: Recommend a dish, with a reason

hints: 理由も添えておすすめしましょう
I'd recommend the … It's …
I'd recommend the salmon. It's one of our most popular dishes.
リクエストに応えましょう
Sure, I can …
Sure, I can ask the kitchen to put it on the side.

title.ja: チップについて説明する

hints: チップは含まれていないと説明しましょう
The tip isn't … Most people leave …
The tip isn't included. Most people leave about 15 to 20 percent.

prop.title: HARBOUR KITCHEN

items.name: Steak with fries and a small salad

prop.foot: Prices don't include tax or tip
